frictions.description: `fill` on the booking sheet's native date input (data-testid=booking-date-input) does not update React state (round-2 friction, still present).
frictions.resolution: Set the value with the HTMLInputElement value setter and dispatched input+change events; the availability call then used date=2026-11-12.

frictions.description: The time-slot buttons have no time-based test id: the 19:00 slot is data-testid=booking-slot-1140 (minutes since midnight), so `find testid "booking-slot-19:00"` fails.
frictions.resolution: Queried the DOM for the button whose text is 19:00 and read its testid, then clicked booking-slot-1140. Clicking a slot only sets the time; the reservation is created by booking-submit-btn.

frictions.description: A first-visit cookie banner overlays the lower-left of the page on the first Book-page load.
frictions.resolution: Clicked the in-page Accept button before interacting with the sheet.

frictions.description: The auto-assigned best-fit table still ignores the selected Dining Area when areaPrefStrict is false (no UI toggle): the sheet sent areaId=area_acme_main and area_pref_id persisted, but the planner assigned G4-2 in G4-Area although free Main Dining Room tables existed on 2026-11-12 (same as round 2).
frictions.resolution: Recorded as an observation; VAL-BOOK-003 only requires the diningAreaId preference to persist plus an occupancy window, both of which hold. Not adjudicated here.

frictions.description: The detail sheet's right panel is taller than the viewport, so a default screenshot clips the Internal notes row.
frictions.resolution: Set document zoom to 0.7 for one extra screenshot (VAL-BOOK-003-detail-sheet-zoomed.png) so the whole field list, including Internal notes contract-internal-book003, is visible.

summary: VAL-BOOK-003 now passes end to end on HEAD 521df7ed (acme, session e1fd6c6d6da7__r3book003, business date 2026-11-12). A phone booking (R3Book Guest One / +15555554001, party 4, Dinner, Main Dining Room, duration 120, occasion Anniversary, dietary notes contract-dietary-book003, internal notes contract-internal-book003, slot 19:00) returned POST 201 (rsv_2248ace9-f6c9-4905-ac69-06e5e031b022, #YKTPAF). The detail sheet renders Occasion Anniversary and Dining area Main Dining Room (names, not raw ids) plus both note strings and '19:00 - 21:00 (120m)', and GET /operator/reservations/book/reservations/:id returns 200 with occasion='anniversary' - the round-2 failure (occasion='tag_acme_anniversary') is fixed - alongside occasionTagId='tag_acme_anniversary', diningAreaId='area_acme_main', durationMin=120, dietaryNotes and internalNotes. The day-feed row for the same id carries the bare occasion too. sqlite confirms rsv_reservations duration_min=120 / occasion_tag_id=tag_acme_anniversary / area_pref_id=area_acme_main / dietary_notes / staff_notes, and the single active rsv_table_occupancies row on G4-2 spans 19:00-21:00 EST = 120.0 min = 120 duration + 0 reset buffer. No console errors; no blockers. Only friction of note (pre-existing, not adjudicated): the auto-assigner still ignores the non-strict Dining Area preference.
